theme: hospital utility plant: steam, chill, and power
title: Ward Block Utility Plant: The Cascade Dispatch Ledger
strategies: dedicated + safety margin: boiler sized 15% over steam demand, electric chiller sized 15% over chill demand, grid covers the rest with the same margin (matches the checker's internal baseline, ~0.1)

exact dedicated sizing: boiler exactly meets steam, electric chiller exactly meets chill (best single-output COP), grid exactly covers the remaining power -- textbook per-commodity efficiency ranking, never routes steam through the turbine

joint cascade dispatch: a 1-D coarse-to-fine search per timestep over how much HP steam to route through the turbine, jointly pricing the electricity AND absorption-chill it yields against the convex grid fuel it displaces, so the schedule automatically falls back to dedicated sizing when the chill:power ratio makes cascading a bad trade

further headroom: temporal smoothing across timesteps (pre-charging LP-steam-fed absorption capacity or shifting boiler load) or an exact convex-program solve of the joint schedule instead of a per-step search
